exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: original mattefiltered HAIR COLOR UV bitmap, not a portrait or photographic hair. Faithfully edit SAME ENTIRE bitmap at higherresolution while preserving sourceblur/nativepaintscale/count/phase/palette/weakpigment/wholeUV/material.

Image1 is ENTIRE exactnative original128square storedRGB madeopaque at ORIGINAL resolution. No NN enlargedtoolguide. NativeOrdinary straightRGB/noPremul/fullsourceA255 andstandard wholebrightnessscalar/defaultpadding restored downstream. Source darkblackRGB/A255 is authoredsourceUVpaint, not empty. Actualsource Material→TemplateID→Models diffuse/hairbindings, NOT dynamicFaceGen COLORoverlay or anatomy inference.

Keep THREE original broad filtered hairCOLOR brushfields in complete128canvas: ONE upper curvedpaint x0..127,y0..35; ONE middle curvedpaint x0..127,y36..91; ONE small lower crosssweptpaint x24..105,y92..127. These are observed source COLORpaintdomains, not three newobjects or inferred locks. Keep originalsourcemuted black/darkwarmgray palette and ALL existing dimbrushstrokes/weakgray/brown peaks/directionalphase/nativepaintscale; same softblur, no brighterrim/gloss/fibers/newcurls. Keep TWO original irregular thin paleangular paintoutlines atnativeLEFT x0..24,y20..61 andRIGHT x102..127,y20..62, exact originalcorners/shortdiagonal/crossbar positions and linecount from reference; do not interpret them as newclips/pins/buckles/glyphs. Source darkgaps andblackUV are opaque authoredRGB/A255, not holes. NativeRGB sourcepeak[156, 142, 140, 255] at[3, 32] stays same flatpaint/localstrength and footprint, no white255 substitute if not original. Preserve entire source dark lowercorners, no grain/mottle or erased paint.

Exact source fullRGBA extrema [[0, 156], [0, 142], [0, 140], [255, 255]]; original nativeweakpigment allpoints/peak strength/graybrown shade hierarchy authoritative. Existing directionalbrushmarks are softlypainted and filtered; no newphysicalstrands or increasing brushstroke count/contrast. Retain the same original bluntsoft ends and gaps, not sharp reconstructed newhair.

Subtle fine rendition of SAME original filtered mattebrush only. NO photo hairfibers/individualhairs/newradiallines/newlocks/curls/syntheticstrandtexture/mosaic/coarsecells/beardgrain/backgroundmottle/granules/grain/shine/glare/glints/brightoutlinedrims/raised seams/metal clips/anatomy/skin/pores/eyebrows/teeth/newparts/letters/logo. Existing paleangularpaintfields remain FLAT SOFT PAINT, not inventedhardware or newglyphs. Do not reveal imaginarydetail under originalblur or whiten weakgraymarks.

Output SAME ENTIRE SQUARE opaqueRGB originalUVcanvas. No whitespace/padding/border/frame/cutout/crop/zoom/recenter/BBox/fitting/islandmoves/registration. Same THREE broadsourcepaintfields/TWO originalthinangularpaintfields/darkcorners and allnativepaintphase/count/sourceA/material/blur/palette.
